subject: 藏地跨年代地域素材：两层大碉房（原创扩展；具体城市年代适用待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Exactly ONE isolated unnamed Tibetan town building sprite for tianshu default kit. True RGBA transparent background with fully solid opaque building. Song reference is ONLY for restrained realistic weathered stone/wood materials and detail density, never for roof type. Tibetan vernacular: slightly battered whitewashed stone walls, flat earthen roof and low parapets, black trapezoidal door/window borders, muted red lintels and dark matte timber. NO pitched Chinese tile roofs, no tourist facades, no glass, no gold on ordinary houses. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, STRICT2:1 dimetric ground slopes+0.5/-0.5, NO perspective. Original entrance on screen lower-left. Base is clear wall-foot parallelogram with left/front/right corners visible, NO plinth, NO terrain rectangle, NO outside objects. Left wall plane illuminated by upper-left light, right wall plane darker, very short lower-right contact shadow. Entire shape plus roof inside frame with at least10% transparent margins. No ambient halo or glow, no floor, sky, scenery, characters, symbols, readable text, checkerboard, watermark, toy/plastic look. Asset bld_kit_tubo_house_large. Footprint7m east-west by6m north-south. Regenerate large two-storey Tibetan house with nearly SQUARE plan, width7 depth6, facade only17 percent wider than side wall. Two windows on each upper face. Keep south door on lower-left face. Do NOT make an elongated rectangle. Make both bottom edge angles26.565degrees from horizontal (+/-0.5 slopes). No stairs beyond footprint. Detailed flat earthen roof. Black-framed windows, no external ladder. Geometric clarity first.
negative: 无文字/现代物/人物/景观背景/厚地台；不拉伸、旋转、重绘或抠白底

references.role: 宋基线仅材质与细节密度参考

created_time_basis: 工具PNG本地mtime，非服务端生成时间

geometry_qa.anchor_method: 人工可见墙脚L/F/R，后角按平行边推算；底面中心=(L+R)/2。非alpha底中点。

steps: alpha>1 determines bounding rectangle only; preserved all pixels inside rectangle
uniform LANCZOS resize with integer pixel rounding
paste without alpha mask onto transparent canvas; no repaint or warp
